asr.full_text: Three reasons why Mirror Trading International is different. Looking for a brand new opportunity? Sure we all are! But choosing the right business is important. There have been many failures in the past, yet we all hope that the next opportunity will be the one that will help us on the road to financial freedom. Will Mirror Trading International be the business you have been looking for? All businesses tell you, you can make money. But can they make a sustained income for you for many years to come? Let's look at three factors which makes Mirror Trading international vastly different from many of the opportunities you may have been offered. No money is ever paid to mirror trading international your trading account is with FX Choice the The ECN brokers. Where your account will copy the trades of the master traders of MTI. You have full control over the funds you have invested You decide when you deposit. and when to withdraw. And you don't need anyone's permission to do so. What is even more important is that withdrawals are almost instantaneous. Let me give you a real example of how this works. One of our members urgently needed money to take his wife to hospital and this was around 7 a.m. on a Tuesday morning. He had started his investment with $250 a week or two prior to his emergency so he knew that some of his money would still be in trades, but was able to withdraw $180 and he received that bitcoin into his wallet before 9am the same morning. Speaking of Bitcoin, that brings me to the second reason Mirror Trading International is so different from the standard company. With Mirror Trading International, Bitcoin is the currency used for the trading. Other companies usually accept Bitcoin and then convert it back to a normal currency like dollars. Your investment is then fixed at that dollar rate. When you fund your trading account with Bitcoin, the value stays in Bitcoin or BTC, otherwise known as bits, which is the BTC value multiplied by 1 million. The value of your investment is always in Bitcoin. So when the price of Bitcoin rises, so will the value of your investment. The daily trading profits are percentages of Bitcoin. When profits are the value of your investment. The Daily Trading Profits are percentages of Bitcoin, when profits are made on your trading account the number of Bitcoin you have increases. Think of the following scenario, you may have 0.03 Bitcoin in your trading account currently, which is worth $300 at the current Bitcoin price of $11,000 per Bitcoin. Should the price go to the predicted $25,000 in the next year the value of your investment could be $750 and that is without taking into consideration the trading profits you will earn. Talking about the profits, Mirror Trading International is a real business and profits are the third reason that makes MTI different. Many people can tell you they are making a profit but, in fact, many companies have lied about the profits they make 100 transparency is needed with mirror trading international you have your own trading account which copies the trades of the master traders appointed by mti when the master traders make a profit it is reflected on your statement proportionally to your investment as it is reflected on every mirror trading International Member's FX Choice statement. When the Traders make a profit on the trading account, the profits are divided accordingly. 40% for you the member, 30% for the Traders who did the work to earn the profit, 10% to MTI for administration and to pay referral bonuses and then another 20% of that profit goes to the profit sharing bonuses within the binary structure of the organization of which you and your team are part. Maritrading International is a real business and bonuses can only be paid if there are profits. Everything is transparent and you as a member will see these results daily in the statements you receive from FXChoice. Let's look at the three reasons again. Your money is with the brokers fx Choice and not with Mirror Trading International. You are in full control, you can deposit and withdraw whenever you like. The investment currency is Bitcoin, and the value of your investment will increase not only from the daily trades but also from the rising price of Bitcoin. Everything is 100% transparent. The profits are real. You receive a daily statement and you can monitor the results and performance of the company for yourself, via your live account.

textual.observation: The promotion presents MTI as a business opportunity that could provide sustained income and help viewers reach financial freedom.

evidence.quote: There have been many failures in the past, yet we all hope that the next opportunity will be the one that will help us on the road to financial freedom.
Will Mirror Trading International be the business you have been looking for?

textual.context: Promotional presentation framing MTI as a potential business or investment opportunity.
textual.potential_relevance: The claimed financial-freedom and sustained-income outcomes are linked to selecting MTI as the viewer's business opportunity.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish typical performance, realized income, or actual financial outcomes.

textual.observation: The source claims that funds deposited into the trading account can be withdrawn almost instantly, illustrated by a $250 investment followed by a $180 bitcoin withdrawal before 9 a.m.

evidence.quote: You decide when you deposit. and when to withdraw. And you don't need anyone's permission to do so.
What is even more important is that withdrawals are almost instantaneous.

He had started his investment with $250 a week or two prior to his emergency so he knew that some of his money would still be in trades, but was able to withdraw $180 and he received that bitcoin into his wallet before 9am the same morning.

textual.context: Presented as a promotional anecdote explaining how the claimed withdrawal process works.
textual.potential_relevance: The source links making an investment or deposit to a specific rapid-withdrawal benefit and a bitcoin transfer to a personal wallet.
textual.limitations: Only one anecdotal example is supplied; typical processing times, fees, eligibility and independent confirmation are not established.

textual.observation: The source links funding the trading account with Bitcoin to possible Bitcoin-price appreciation and additional daily trading profits, using a conditional $300-to-$750 example.

evidence.quote: When you fund your trading account with Bitcoin, the value stays in Bitcoin or BTC
Should the price go to the predicted $25,000 in the next year the value of your investment could be $750 and that is without taking into consideration the trading profits you will earn.

textual.context: Presented as a conditional scenario using a predicted Bitcoin price and the word "could," rather than as a stated guarantee.
textual.potential_relevance: The requested act of funding a trading account with Bitcoin is directly linked to a projected increase in investment value plus trading profits.
textual.limitations: The example depends on a price prediction and does not establish realized returns, certainty or a guarantee.

textual.observation: The source describes a profit-allocation and referral-bonus structure in which trading profits are divided among members, traders and MTI, with additional bonuses tied to a binary organization and the viewer's team.

another 20% of that profit goes to the profit sharing bonuses within the binary structure of the organization of which you and your team are part.

textual.context: Promotional description of how stated profits and bonuses are allocated; no explicit recruitment instruction is stated.
textual.potential_relevance: The trading-profit claim is linked to team membership and referral bonuses within a binary structure, making the participation and bonus mechanics relevant for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not provide eligibility criteria, explicit recruitment steps or evidence that bonuses were actually paid.

textual.observation: The promotion claims that the trading account is held with FX Choice rather than MTI and copies trades made by MTI's master traders.

evidence.quote: No money is ever paid to mirror trading international your trading account is with FX Choice the The ECN brokers.

textual.context: Presented as a reassuring feature of the promotional investment arrangement.
textual.potential_relevance: The source presents a named broker and copy-trading setup as the mechanism for holding deposited funds and generating the stated returns.
textual.limitations: The records do not verify the broker relationship, account ownership, trade execution or actual movement of funds.

visual.observation: The presentation advertises a role-based financial arrangement showing “40% Members,” “30% Traders,” “10% Admin / Referral Bonuses,” and “20% Profit Sharing.”
visual.context: Promotional business presentation; the sampled frame does not show a specific viewer instruction or enrollment step.
visual.potential_relevance: The displayed referral-bonus and profit-sharing claims are tied to participation roles, which may merit review for how rewards are obtained and distributed.
visual.limitations: The frame does not establish whether any payment, recruitment, trading result, or bonus actually occurred, nor does it show the governing terms.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes MTI as an automated investment opportunity and solicits participants to deposit Bitcoin into a trading account that copies MTI traders’ trades. It supports the pitch with claims of near-immediate withdrawals, possible future trading profits, profit allocations, and referral and team-based bonuses, although the records do not verify the trading results, withdrawals, or bonus payments.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The video promotes funding a trading account that copies master traders' trades and presents resulting trading profits as an investment opportunity. It also describes a binary organizational structure in which profit-sharing bonuses and referral bonuses are paid, supporting S06 as a secondary mechanism.

evidence.observation: The speaker links a portion of profits to bonuses within a binary organization involving the member and their team.
